description.en: One dark capsule follows six navigation items, changes width, and reveals anchored labels through a moving crop. The profile uses the LeiBox logo.
description.zh: 黑色胶囊随六个导航入口移动、变宽，通过裁切切换文字；头像使用 LeiBox Logo。

keywords: 流体 提示 气泡 胶囊 导航 侧栏 悬浮 Logo LeiBox fluid tooltip capsule navigation sidebar hover profile

discovery.caveat: 默认仅切换本地选中项，通过 onSelect 接入导航；Logo 与提示文字可替换。

source.implementation: Independent LeiBox DOM/CSS/GSAP tooltip implementation with an embedded brand mark, Lucide icons and Inter font.
source.license: Retain source notices and design-reference attribution; no blanket license is assigned by the catalog.

notice.en: Complete source files from this project's existing framework package. Preserve included notices and reference attribution.
notice.zh: 提供本站已有框架代码包的完整文件，保留源码声明与设计参考署名。

instructions.en: Hover or focus the icons to move the tooltip. Click to select; arrow keys move focus and Escape closes it.
instructions.zh: 悬停或聚焦图标移动提示，点击选中；方向键切换焦点，Escape 收起。
